name: NEO TITAN
description:
About This Game

CHALLENGE THE TITANS' REIGN

Prophecy foretold that the universe was to end and begin anew, but instead, the Titans appeared. With their arrival, intelligent life vanished, and a decaying universe was cast into an eternal slumber.

Explore an alien planet filled with fearsome creatures, robotic allies, and the all-powerful Titans. Empower yourself with gadgets, weapons, and abilities, in an attempt to slay the Titans and free the world from their reign.

Game Features

  • Engage in challenging twin-stick combat - recharge your firearm by striking enemies with your blade

  • Explore a vast, interconnected alien planet - uncover secrets and shortcuts in the depths of dangerous alien ecosystems

  • Customise your build - collect and equip a variety of modules which enhance your offensive and defensive capabilities

  • Discover new combat and movement abilities, each expanding your reach in the world

  • Fight powerful beasts and titans in difficult bullet-hell boss battles

  • Uncover the planet's past, and play your part in deciding its fate
short_desc: NEO TITAN is a challenging twin-stick metroidvania - Explore a world filled with dangerous alien ecosystems, discover new abilities, and challenge powerful Titans to save an ill-fated planet.
